definitions.median_c5: close five sessions later ÷ next-session open − 1
definitions.ci_pct_dump: 95% bootstrap interval, 1000 resamples of whole dates
definitions.lift_dump: study dump rate ÷ dump rate of all rows where the condition could be evaluated

caveats: Conditional base rates, not a trading system: no borrow, fees or slippage.
Universe = names listed today (survivorship bias); delisted collapses are missing.
Filing-based studies only cover names with SEC filing history in the data.

baseline.title: All eligible name-days
baseline.condition: every labeled row (price ≥ $0.10, 20-day median $ volume ≥ $50k, ≥ 60 prior sessions)
baseline.plain: Across every eligible small/micro-cap session (1,722,303 cases across 3,372 stocks), the next session fell 5%+ from open to close 9.1% of the time (95% CI 8.7%–9.4%). Median open→close -0.1%; it closed below its open 51.1% of the time and squeezed 20%+ above the open 1.2% of the time.

studies.title: All eligible name-days
studies.condition: every labeled row (price ≥ $0.10, 20-day median $ volume ≥ $50k, ≥ 60 prior sessions)
studies.plain: Across every eligible small/micro-cap session (1,722,303 cases across 3,372 stocks), the next session fell 5%+ from open to close 9.1% of the time (95% CI 8.7%–9.4%). Median open→close -0.1%; it closed below its open 51.1% of the time and squeezed 20%+ above the open 1.2% of the time.

studies.title: Up 20%+ on the day
studies.plain: After a stock closed up 20% or more on the day (12,350 cases across 2,131 stocks), the next session fell 5%+ from open to close 38.3% of the time (95% CI 37.2%–39.4%) — 4.23× the 9.1% rate for comparable name-days. Median open→close -2.1%; it closed below its open 57.7% of the time and squeezed 20%+ above the open 15.9% of the time.

studies.title: Gap-up over 30% (same session, from the open)
studies.condition: next-session open ≥ 30% above the prior close; outcome measured from that open
studies.plain: When a stock opened 30% or more above the prior close (2,428 cases across 985 stocks), that same session fell 5%+ from open to close 60.0% of the time (95% CI 58.0%–62.1%) — 6.63× the 9.1% rate for comparable name-days. Median open→close -10.2%; it closed below its open 68.1% of the time and squeezed 20%+ above the open 40.6% of the time.

Median open→close -1.1%; it closed below its open 55.3% of the time and squeezed 20%+ above the open 9.3% of the time.
